text.text: Melee hits apply Void Touched for 5 seconds. A fully charged attack releases a piercing void slash that deals 9 damage and lasts 0.5 seconds.

Right-click to backstep with a 1-second cooldown. Sprint-right-click to dash forward, dealing 9 damage and applying Void Touched along the path, with a 7-second cooldown. Neither movement nor void slashes work during cooldown.

effects: Requires a sword containing Dark Metal
